small_guidance: Reorder the conv_transpose loop nest so the IC reduction is the innermost loop accumulating into one acc tensor and the (kd,kh,kw) loops are outside; currently acc is reset inside the kw loop and atomic_add is issued KD*KH*KW times per (n,oc,sp) tile, causing the 86% L2 traffic and high register pressure (128 reg/thread, occ 33%). Also drop num_stages=1→2, lower BLOCK_OC to 8 or BLOCK_SP to 64 to cut registers, and replace the separate init_bias_kernel by initializing out with bias inside the scatter epilogue (or use torch broadcast fill).
large_guidance: Rewrite as a gather-style direct conv (one program per (N, OC tile, output-spatial tile)) where each output voxel loops over the valid (kd,kh,kw,ic) taps that map back to integer input coords (od+PD-kd divisible by SD). This eliminates atomics entirely, allows a real GEMM-style tl.dot over IC*KD*KH*KW, and lets you fuse the BN affine and the spatial-mean subtraction: do a two-pass kernel — pass 1 computes conv+BN and per-(N,C) sum via atomics or a second small kernel; pass 2 subtracts mean — or fuse all three (convT, BN, mean-sub) by emitting conv+BN output and accumulating the channel sum in the same kernel, then a tiny finalize kernel does y -= mean. Use channels_last (NDHWC) layout so OC is the contiguous GEMM-N axis.
